query:
UPDATE tasks SET
                            title = $1, description = $2, design = $3,
                            priority = $4, owner = $5, labels = $6,
                            acceptance_criteria = $7,
                            updated_at = to_char(now() at time zone 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')
                         WHERE id = $8
